notes: The semantic palette now lives in globals.css, before public, workspace and portal styles. All referenced workspace color tokens have one definition. The measured action-height layout variable is assigned dynamically and is not a missing color.

Before records preserve the original root defaults and homepage gallery overrides. plans-desktop-before-surface-fix shows the gray 8px panel before the white 12px contract was applied; later plan hover/focus and small-phone records supersede it.

Public pricing, workspace Add a photo and portal plan actions resolve to the same opaque primary fill and legible foreground. Public and dialog pricing also match typography, padding, radius and gap. Public header/marketing controls demonstrate the 44px and 52px variants. Disabled Pro remains natively unavailable.

Pointer hover was obtained by dragging from blank card padding into the action; it did not activate the action. The drag selected part of Continue free in one screenshot. That selection is a test artifact, not a product label treatment. Held pressed-state rendering was not captured; UX-01.2 and the complete UX-07 state contract remain open.

A direct locator-focus sequence left the phone pricing link offscreen. It is retained as pricing-phone-locator-focus-offscreen and does not pass visual keyboard access. On a fresh page, four native Tab presses reached Try it free fully within the viewport; pricing-phone-native-tab-final and palette-pricing-phone.jpg are authoritative. Enter also reached the guest Photo Studio.

Plan dismissal initially lost focus when the original trigger disappeared on resize. The final fallback returns to More workspace options at 320px and the desktop Plans button at 1280px. Both destinations are visible, at least 44px high and focus-visible. Pending close now has disabled styling/semantics consistent with the existing busy guard; no checkout request was made to test that state.

Settings, Post sheet, saved posts, Explore detail, public sign-in, public navigation and the public photo dialog were inspected. White dialog surfaces and semantic text colors resolve outside workspace ancestors. Edge-to-edge settings and bottom-sheet corner exceptions are preserved.

The homepage gallery moved from cream, olive selection and brown focus to the shared surface/canvas/selected/focus roles. Arrow navigation changed New backdrop to From above, updated the image and heading, and was restored. Closing restored focus to the enlargement button; its green/white inset frame was measured and visually inspected.

UX-09.1/09.3/09.4/09.5 remain open for the remaining legacy-role inventory, complete hierarchy/state-cue review and custom-artwork preservation checks. This phase does not establish full browser/device coverage, enlarged text, every button state or independent human acceptance.

Final typecheck, build and application+menu suites pass. Lint remains 84 existing errors and 1698 warnings, with no unmatched errors. Recovery remains deferred. No credentials were entered, no restaurant values changed and no billing, generation, publishing or deployment action occurred. The local workspace and normal viewport are restored.
